titles: "애물단지"라며 안 지은 선수촌…한국 선수촌은 44억 아파트가 됐다
선수는 크루즈선에서 잤다…한국 선수촌이 44억 아파트가 된 진짜 이유
일본 보고서에 적힌 '인천'…선수촌도 못 지은 나고야의 진짜 이유
thumbnail_texts: "첫 분양 세 채 중 한 채" / 그래도 짓고, 사람이 살았다

image_concepts.A: 나고야항 부두의 크루즈선·컨테이너 숙소(일장기) ↔ 가운데 당황한 익명 농구 선수 ↔ 황금빛 석양의 송파 선수촌 아파트 단지(태극기)
image_concepts.B: 발이 삐져나오는 비좁은 컨테이너 방 ↔ 가운데 놀란 익명 일본인 50대 남성 ↔ 햇살 가득한 넓은 한국 선수촌 아파트 거실

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사. 왼쪽 비 젖은 나고야항 부두의 거대한 크루즈선과 흰 컨테이너 숙소 줄(일장기), 가운데 트레이닝복 차림의 키 큰 익명 아시아 농구 선수가 당황한 표정, 오른쪽 석양을 받은 송파 고층 아파트 단지(태극기).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR cinematic three-panel contrast image. On the left, a huge white Italian cruise ship moored at a rainy, gray Nagoya port pier with rows of small white container huts in front of it, desaturated cool blue-gray tones, and a Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) waving in the upper-left corner. In the center, a very tall, attractive young Asian male basketball player with a warm likeable face in a national team tracksuit, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, exaggerated bewildered expression with mouth open. On the right, a large 1980s-style Korean high-rise apartment complex in Seoul's Songpa district glowing under a golden sunset with warm backlight and blue-white sparkle, and a Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the upper-right corner.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 변형. 크루즈선을 정면으로 크게 잡고 가운데 놀란 익명 여성 육상 선수, 오른쪽에 불 켜진 선수촌 아파트 동들과 태극기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic HDR split composition. The left third shows the towering bow of a massive cruise ship docked at an industrial Japanese container pier under overcast sky, muted desaturated colors, with a Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) in the upper-left corner. In the center, an attractive young Asian female track athlete with a warm likeable face wearing a team jacket, chest-up close-up, wide-eyed shocked expression, filling about 60% of the frame height. The right third shows warmly lit Korean athletes' village apartment towers at dusk with glowing windows and a lush park in front, golden backlight, and a Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the upper-right corner.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사. 왼쪽 형광등 아래 비좁은 컨테이너 방(침대 끝으로 발이 삐져나옴, 일장기), 가운데 놀란 익명 일본인 50대 정장 남성, 오른쪽 창밖 단지가 보이는 햇살 가득한 넓은 아파트 거실(태극기).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR three-panel interior contrast image. On the left, a cramped, narrow wooden container room lit by cold fluorescent light, with a short single bed where a tall athlete's feet stick out past the end, gray desaturated tones, and a Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) in the upper-left corner. In the center, an attractive Japanese businessman in his 50s with a warm likeable face in a dark suit, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, exaggerated surprised expression with raised eyebrows and open mouth. On the right, a spacious, bright Korean apartment living room flooded with warm sunlight, large windows showing green apartment complex grounds outside, glowing warm tones, and a Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the upper-right corner.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사 변형. 왼쪽 빗물 고인 컨테이너 화장실 바닥과 좁은 복도(일장기), 가운데 놀란 익명 키 큰 선수, 오른쪽 넓은 베란다에서 내려다본 녹지 가득한 선수촌 단지(태극기).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic HDR split image. On the left, a small prefab container bathroom with water puddled across the floor beneath a leaking sink and a narrow dim corridor, cold desaturated tones, with a Japanese national flag (white flag with red circle) in the upper-left corner. In the center, a tall, attractive young Asian male athlete with a warm likeable face in a sports hoodie, chest-up close-up, exaggerated disbelieving expression, filling about 60% of the frame height. On the right, a wide sunlit balcony view over a green, tree-filled Korean apartment complex with mid-rise towers, warm golden light and blue-white glow, and a Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the upper-right corner.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 실사 — Before→After. 왼쪽 1988년 빛바랜 사진 톤의 갓 지은 올림픽 선수촌 단지와 텅 빈 분양 사무소, 오른쪽 2026년 고채도의 울창한 같은 단지와 재건축 조감 느낌의 빛나는 스카이라인.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic before-and-after split composition. The left half shows a newly built late-1980s Korean apartment complex with fan-shaped low-rise blocks in faded, sepia-toned vintage photo style, with an almost empty sales office tent and a few people in 1980s clothing in front. The right half shows the same neighborhood today, lush with mature trees and a gleaming modern skyline of luxury apartment towers, vivid high-saturation colors with warm golden backlight and blue-white sparkle, and a Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the upper-right corner. A clean vertical light seam divides past and present.
